design_philosophy: Inspired by Toggl Track. Clean, minimal, professional, highly functional. Absolute zero decorative gradients. Every element serves an operational purpose.

layout.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar, width 256px (w-64), background #F7F8FA, border-r border-[#E5E7EB]. Flex col for navigation items. Icons + Labels.
layout.topbar: Flex row, items-center, justify-between. Height 72px (h-18). Background #FFFFFF, border-b border-[#E5E7EB]. Left: Page Title (H1). Right: Primary Action Button in solid blue.
layout.cards: bg-white border border-[#E5E7EB] shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] rounded-xl (12px radius). Internal padding p-6.

buttons.primary: bg-[#0066FF] text-white hover:bg-[#0052CC] rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors border border-transparent shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#4B5563] hover:bg-gray-50 border border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors

components.badges: rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium tracking-wide
components.inputs: bg-white border border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-[#0A0A0A] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0066FF]/20 focus:border-[#0066FF]
components.table: w-full text-left text-sm text-[#4B5563]. Th: font-medium text-[#6B7280] border-b border-[#E5E7EB] py-3. Td: py-4 border-b border-[#E5E7EB].

interactions.hover: Subtle background shifts for list items (hover:bg-gray-50), color shifts for buttons. No scaling or translating (keep it flat and professional).

logo.description: Green leaf Quotify logo on black background. Use in sidebar header.

images.description: Smiling contractor in red hard hat.

testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case, role-based.
instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use gradients anywhere. Flat colors only.
Use Manrope for all headings (H1-H4) to satisfy design system constraints while keeping a clean aesthetic, and Inter for body text.
Use exactly #F7F8FA for the sidebar background.
Use 12px rounded corners (rounded-xl in Tailwind) for cards and modals.
Pill badges must use the exact status colors provided (Draft=Gray, Sent=Blue, Accepted=Green, Declined=Red).
Include the provided logo URL in the sidebar.
Ensure the layout is a fixed left sidebar with a top header for the main content.
Follow standard clean SaaS dashboard patterns with fully responsive HTML/Tailwind CSS components.
For icons, use lucide-react as standard.
